title: kaijutsu Skill Manifest
description: Schema for skill.yaml — the per-skill metadata file consumed by the jutsu CLI.

name.description: Lowercase-kebab-case skill identifier; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

license.description: SPDX license identifier. Must be MIT or in the configured allowlist (BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, ISC, Apache-2.0).

layout.description: flat = SKILL.md + scripts/. rich = Anthropic progressive-disclosure layout with references/, runbooks/, scripts/, assets/, subagents/.

description.description: Single-sentence summary used by jutsu search and info.

agents.description: Which agents this skill has been authored / tested for.

shared.description: Rich layout only: top-level dirs that are agent-agnostic and shared across install targets.

bash.description: Whether the skill executes shell commands.

network.description: Whether the skill makes network requests.

fs-write.description: false = read-only; 'scoped' = writes limited to the user's project tree and agent state dirs (.claude/, .codex/, .gemini/, .agents/); 'full' = unrestricted writes anywhere on disk.

expected-signer.description: GitHub identity (e.g. kaijutsu-core@github) the CLI will verify the Sigstore bundle against. Authors do NOT self-assert signed=true; the CLI derives it from successful cosign verify-blob.
